causal_interval_note: Incident bootstrap intervals are exploratory because constructed telemetry repeats templates.

request_attempt_elapsed_seconds.measurement_scope: Timed provider call plus response parsing across attempts; excludes prompt construction and trace writes.

serial_request_plus_tcb_path_seconds.measurement_scope: Sum of relevant recorded request-attempt elapsed times and condition TCB time. Not observed end-to-end wall-clock; excludes prompt construction, trace writes, and scheduling overhead.

minority_flip.eligibility_limitations: Excludes correct deferrals and does not establish uniquely private disambiguating evidence.

model_identity_audit.interpretation: Exact returned model IDs must match requested IDs for a primary claim; aliases or unavailable versions require explicit resolution.

unsubmitted_raw_proof_snippets.interpretation: raw snippets in failed replies; never submitted to the verifier
